description: For every finite set \(\Gamma\) of sentences and sentence \(A\), the sublanguage with exactly the symbols occurring in \(\Gamma\) or \(A\) admits a finite set \(\Gamma_0\) and sentence \(A_0\) whose canonical inclusion translations are precisely \(\Gamma\) and \(A\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.finite_language_factorization.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (Γ : Finset L.Sentence) (A : L.Sentence) :
  ∃ S Γ₀ A₀,
    S =
        Γ.biUnion Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols ∪
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols A ∧
      Finset.image (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportInclusion S).onSentence Γ₀ = Γ ∧
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportInclusion S).onSentence A₀ = A
